equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; the patient's age is a case-report descriptor only.

notes: A single case report plus laboratory testing of 10 purchased products (9 of 10 contained yellow oleander). It has no group comparison, so data_focus is limited. UHPLC-mass spectrometry is a lab identification method, not a statistical procedure; the study design is inferred.
view_issues: Serum digoxin level is reported as 0.5 ng/L (likely ng/mL). Products were purchased in December 2022, but the table is dated January–May 2023, while the title says 2022.
